canary_primary_result.failure_pattern: The RGB-only global heads were not parent-stable: camera height and support normal each failed the frozen positive-improvement requirement on at least one of two fresh parents for every seed.

uncertainty_result.interpretation: The learned sigma fields improved their bound proper scores. The six-frame mean-sigma/four-bin diagnostic is too coarse to establish residual ordering and remains unproven; no uncertainty pass is claimed.

decision.attempt03_scope: Replace only support normal and camera height with deployment-available gravity and deterministic depth/K/support geometry; evaluate uncertainty ordering at pixel granularity; use fresh parent-disjoint selection and canary sources.

claim_boundary: TRAIN-only factor learnability evidence. Eight factor/proper-score metrics transferred to two fresh parents; full F1 factor learnability, reducer utility, deployment, product and safety remain unproven.
